_README: Hand-authored ANALYSIS specs (sub-step 3c). Each entry is one analysis — a comparison/finding OVER conditions (leaderboard, hypothesis test, sweep, ...). The generator (scripts/generate_post_run_report.py) validates these, attaches provenance, and emits results/analyses-manifest.json (+ .md). HYBRID authoring: the machine-fillable keys (analysis_id, type, conditions_compared, output_path) are authored here; the human-authored fields (outcome, hypothesis_refs, preregistered, deviations, predicted_outcome, tie_set, paper_section, working_notes_obs) may stay null until a human writes the finding + preregistration linkage, per the schema's lenient back-fill. Set manually_verified_at when a human has authored/verified a row. Schema: docs/manifest-schemas/analyses-manifest.schema.json.

analyses._note: The N=1 single-pass baseline leaderboard at 384px (the cross-architecture model x modality x thinking x temperature matrix). FINDING (authored 2026-06-03; REVISED twice same day: E57 genuine-Pro replace, then the n=3 completeness top-up): tie_set + outcome from a round-robin tile-swap permutation (replicate-mean per-tile, 10k perms, seed 42, two-sided) + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q=0.05) + greedy-clique tiering at the 20 m headline buffer -> 7 tiers (129/153 pairs significant); Tier 1 (tie_set) = TWO genuine-Pro text cells at T=0.0 -- pro-text-high-t-0-0 (n1-pro-rerun-384, F1 0.804) + pro-text-medium-t-0-0 (pv-diag-384, F1 0.792) -- statistically indistinguishable, both clear of the Tier-2 pair (the two Pro-text T=0.7 cells, 0.755/0.745). All four anti-diagonal Pro cells are the genuine-Pro re-run (n1-pro-rerun-384), REPLACING the Flash-misdispatched n1-outstanding cells (E57), and all four medium-thinking Pro cells were brought to n=3 (the pv-diag medium-t-0-0 run_1 had ~5% unretried tile failures that had depressed its score; recovered to 487/487 -- Obs 338/339). The intermediate 'sole leader' result (pre-top-up) was an artefact of that incomplete run_1. Result artefacts: results/paper-eval/n1/384px-14buf-mcc/tiering/tiering_20m.{json,md}; script: scripts/n1_baseline_leaderboard_tiering.py. This single-pass board is the baseline comparator the consensus (H3) and proposer-verifier (H2) architectures are measured against. See docs/methodology/n1-baseline-matrix.md and planning/leaderboard-construction-plan.md.
analyses.predicted_outcome: Preregistered directions come from earlier Gemini-3-Flash / 512 px phases (this board is Gemini 3 at 384 px): H6 (Phase 4, the only untested confirmatory hypothesis) expected the stronger Pro model to transfer/match-or-exceed Flash; H7 (Phase 2b) found T=0.0 optimal for both tracks; H1 (Phase 2a) planned a text-only vs image-using contrast without a committed directional winner. Board result (post-E57, genuine Pro, all medium cells at n=3): H6 holds strongly and uniformly -- the top six cells are all genuine Pro, every Pro-text cell beats the best Flash cell (flash-image-minimal-t-0-0, F1 0.600), and the genuine Pro-image cells match Flash on F1 while dominating MCC; the earlier apparent 'Flash beats weak Pro' (the pre-E57 board had Flash image-MINIMAL 0.59-0.60 above 'Pro' configs at 0.42-0.53) was an ARTEFACT of the Flash-misdispatched anti-diagonal -- those four cells were Flash, not Pro (E57), and genuine Pro at the same corners scores 0.59-0.80. H7's T=0.0 optimum is now CLEANLY supported within Pro text: the two Tier-1 cells are both T=0.0 (HIGH and MEDIUM thinking, tied) and the two Tier-2 cells are both T=0.7 -- a clear T=0.0 > T=0.7 ordering at matched model/modality. H1 resolves metric-dependently -- text wins F1@20 m localisation (the top four cells are all text) while image wins MCC tile-discrimination (pro-image-medium-t-0-7, MCC +0.911).
analyses.outcome: At the preregistered 20 m buffer the best single pass for mound localisation is genuine Gemini 3 Pro text at T=0.0. Tier 1 -- the tie_set -- is a two-member statistical tie between pro-text-high-t-0-0 (n1-pro-rerun-384; F1 0.804) and pro-text-medium-t-0-0 (pv-diag-384; F1 0.792): a round-robin tile-swap permutation (BH-FDR q=0.05; 129/153 pairs significant -> 7 tiers) cannot separate them, and both are significantly clear of the Tier-2 pair -- the two Pro-text T=0.7 cells, pro-text-medium-t-0-7 (0.755) and pro-text-high-t-0-7 (0.745). So at T=0.0 the thinking level (HIGH vs MEDIUM) does not significantly matter, and T=0.0 beats T=0.7 (Tier 1 vs Tier 2) at matched model and modality (H7). The top four cells are all Pro text and the top six all genuine Pro; the text-over-image advantage holds at matched settings (best Pro text 0.804 vs best Pro image 0.666). The F1 leaders are NOT the tile-level discrimination (MCC) leader: genuine Pro IMAGE wins MCC -- pro-image-medium-t-0-7 (MCC +0.911, but 9th on F1) and pro-image-high-t-0-0 (+0.868) -- while Pro text leads F1, so the best single-pass configuration is metric-dependent. Provenance: all four anti-diagonal Pro cells are the genuine-Pro re-run (the n1-outstanding originals were Flash, E57); all four medium-thinking cells are n=3, after recovering ~5% unretried tile failures in the pv-diag medium-t-0-0 run_1 that had depressed it to 0.763 (Obs 338/339). The brief intermediate 'sole leader' result was an artefact of that incomplete pass.
